name: asc-ad-hoc-distribution
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: A paid Apple Developer Program account.
A PKCS#12 signing identity, a devices file, an S3 bucket and jq.
risks: Registers devices and creates provisioning profiles; it applies only after the user authorizes the exact plan hash (SKILL.md:44).
Treat the install URL as a secret.
